proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    have key : ∀ x : A, x ≠ 0 → ∃ y : A, y * x = 1 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases h (Ideal.span {x}) with h1 | h1
      · exfalso; apply hx
        rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] at h1
        exact h1
      · have : (1 : A) ∈ Ideal.span {x} := by rw [h1]; trivial
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp this
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := key a ha
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := key b hb0
    have hca : c = a := by
      calc c = c * (b * a) := by rw [hb, mul_one]
        _ = (c * b) * a := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = a := by rw [hc, one_mul]
    exact ⟨⟨a, b, by rw [← hca]; exact hc, hb⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro h J
    by_cases hJ : J = ⊥
    · exact Or.inl hJ
    · right
      obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hJ
      exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem J ha (h a ha0)
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] [Nontrivial A], (∀ J : Ideal A, J = ⊥ ∨ J = ⊤) ↔ ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → IsUnit a
